relationships.evidence_quote: In parallel, levels of spinal cord IL-1β and TNF-α were significantly increased in the AXT+VEH group compared to the naïve group, 28 days after axotomy (Figs 7M, N). Notably, spinal cords from AXT+IMT504 group displayed reduced glial marker immunoreactivities and cells exhibiting activated phenotypes

key_findings: IMT504 recruited MSCs to neuroma and DRG, produced an anti-inflammatory milieu, and strongly prevented autotomy after sciatic axotomy in rats.
IMT504 reduced satellite glial GFAP in DRG and astro/microgliosis plus IL-1β and TNF-α in spinal cord; human neuroma ex vivo showed the same cytokine shift.
